mode: Supabase MCP read-only catalog/ledger and aggregate integrity

policies.name: Users can delete own notes
policies.using:
((auth.uid() = user_id) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM user_books b
  WHERE ((b.id = reading_notes.user_book_id) AND (b.user_id = auth.uid())))))

triggers.name: reading_notes_manage_revision
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER reading_notes_manage_revision BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.reading_notes FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION library_manage_note_revision()

constraints.name: reading_notes_book_owner_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_book_id, user_id) REFERENCES user_books(id, user_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: reading_notes_user_book_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_book_id) REFERENCES user_books(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: reading_notes_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

note: No authenticated business mutation, note body or identity read; effective privileges and trigger source are catalog evidence.
